quarterly_data.quarter: NVIDIA press release: NVIDIA, Nokia and Leading Telecom Operators Turn Networks (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NVIDIA (release): T-Mobile completed the first AI-RAN call on its commercial network in Bellevue, Washington, on commercial NVIDIA Aerial RAN Computer (ARC) servers with Nokia's CUDA-accelerated RAN software; nearly 20 telecom operators have publicly announced AI-RAN collaborations using Nokia anyRAN software and NVIDIA ARC, with trials planned at BT (2027), Deutsche Telekom, Elisa and Orange, and Elisa has deployed ARC at a distributed network location. Nine EMEA operators are building or expanding NVIDIA-powered infrastructure (new: CRA, etisalat, Silknet, TIM; expansions: Cassava, Deutsche Telekom, Fastweb + Vodafone, Kazakhtelecom, Orion Telecom). NVIDIA introduced ARC MGX 2U and 4U configurations on RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs, with ARC-ready servers from Dell Technologies, Quanta Cloud Technology and Supermicro; Nokia and Cisco are integrating NVIDIA Nemotron models into network-operations software.
quarterly_data.figure: nearly 20 operators with Nokia-NVIDIA AI-RAN collaborations
